$comment: Orientation of the planetary rotation axes. Pole right ascension and declination are the IAU Working Group on Cartographic Coordinates and Rotational Elements (WGCCRE) J2000 values, which are the same constants carried by the NAIF planetary constants kernels. rotationPhaseSource documents where the prime-meridian angle W comes from: 'convention-zero-at-j2000' means the rotation RATE and AXIS are real (NASA/NSSDC sidereal period + IAU pole) while the epoch phase is a documented convention, because no prime-meridian constant is bundled offline.
source: IAU WGCCRE / NAIF planetary constants (J2000 poles)
rotationRateSource: NASA/NSSDC Planetary Fact Sheet (sidereal rotation period)
